newsitem.title: USA: PMT Services in $22.5 million merger deal.
newsitem.headline: PMT Services in $22.5 million merger deal.

text.p: PMT Services Inc said on Wednesday that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire LADCO Financial Group, a credit card terminal leasing company, for $22.5 million.
"As a result of this acquisition, PMT expects to improve its ability to offer a turnkey electronic processing service to its subsidiaries and marchant accounts," PMT said in a statement.
In addition, the company said it had aquired an independent, unnamed service organization with about 1,300 merchant accounts.
Terms of the second transaction and a purchase price were not disclosed.
PMT Services Inc is a service organization that markets electronic credit card authorization and payment systems.
